meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Luxury Home!* Brand New Luxury Home in Seacrest Beach Neighborhood* Private Beach Access * Pet Friendly (add
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Luxury Home!* Brand New Luxury Home in Seacrest Beach Neighborhood* Private Beach Access * Pet Friendly (add'l $200 fee)* 4 Bikes Included* Expansive Rooftop Deck – Outdoor Kitchen and Dining Area – Enjoy meals and drinks while taking in the beautiful coastal surroundings* 12,000 Sq. Ft. Community Pool – Enjoy access to Seacrest Beach's famous resort-style pool* Close to Shops and Restaurants-Perfect Location Between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. **Smart home technology is used to help ensure policy compliance and may include remotely monitored thermostats, door locks, a decibel meter, and video surveillance, including the front door.**We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs November thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Welcome to Palms By The Sea Main House, a beautifully designed luxury home in the heart of Seacrest Beach. The rooftop deck is the star of the show, offering an outdoor kitchen and dining area where you can gather for meals, enjoy evening cocktails, or watch the sunset over the beautiful Emerald Coast. The gourmet kitchen includes quartz countertops and premium appliances, making it easy to prepare family meals and entertain your group. Palms By The Sea Main House offers four bedrooms and four bathrooms, comfortably sleeping up to 14 guests. Two Master bedrooms feature King beds, while the Queen bedroom provides additional comfort. The second-floor bunk room is a favorite spot for kids and larger groups, features two Twin-over-Full bunk beds. Whether you're relaxing by the pool, spending the day at the beach, or gathering together under the stars, Palms By The Sea Main House offers the perfect blend of luxury, location, and laid-back 30A charm.*Please Note: Palms by the Sea Main House is the separate retreat and is one of two individual rental units. Your reservation is for Palms by the Sea Main House only. The second unit may be occupied by other guests during your stay. The Bed Setup:1st FloorMaster Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: Queen BedSecond-FloorBunk Room: 2 Twin-over-Full Bunk Beds3rd Floor:Master Bedroom: King BedArea Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World-style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
